content.short: 0vix is a Polygon lending market for lending, borrowing, and earning interest, with plans to add veTokenomics and dynamic interest rates.
content.description: 0vix DeFi liquidity market protocol on Polygon that enables users to lend, borrow, and earn interest on digital assets. It originated as a fork of Compound and is commonly described as Polygon's liquidity market. By operating on Polygon, it reduces Ethereum gas costs and network congestion, lowering the barrier to entry for users with limited capital. The protocol plans to introduce veTokenomics and dynamic interest rates.
